lockScreen.title: Vault Locked
lockScreen.subtitle: End-to-end encryption (E2EE) is active. Enter your master password to decrypt your financial data.
lockScreen.demoBannerDesc: You are exploring the demo portfolio. Unlock in 1 click without having to enter your master password.
lockScreen.recoveryKeyHint: Enter the 32-character recovery key generated when your vault was created.
lockScreen.forgotPrompt: Forgot password and lost your recovery key?
lockScreen.resetConfirmMessage: Warning: Due to end-to-end encryption, data cannot be recovered without the password or recovery key. Resetting will permanently wipe your encrypted local storage and restore default demo data.
lockScreen.invalidCredentials: The master password or recovery key is incorrect.
lockScreen.resetFailed: The vault could not be reset. Please try again.
lockScreen.signOutPrompt: Not you, or prefer to sign in again? You are signed in as {{email}}.

vaultSection.title: Encrypted Vault (E2EE)
vaultSection.subtitle: All your transactions, positions, and credentials are encrypted locally with AES-256-GCM.
vaultSection.passwordChangedSuccess: Master password changed successfully. Encryption keys re-wrapped.
vaultSection.managedByGoogle: Authentication & Vault managed by Google OAuth
vaultSection.regenerateSubtitle: Confirm your master password to derive a fresh 256-bit recovery key.
vaultSection.googleRecoveryMissing: No recovery key yet. Your vault opens with your Google account only: create a key to open it if you ever lose access to that account.
vaultSection.googleRecoveryPresent: A recovery key exists for this vault.
vaultSection.googleRecoveryRedirectNote: You will be sent to Google to confirm it is you, then brought back here.

totp.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA / TOTP)
totp.subtitle: Protect your account with Google Authenticator, 1Password, or Authy
totp.challengeSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app or an emergency backup code.
totp.managedByGoogle: 2FA is managed directly by your Google Account
totp.statusEnabled: 2FA is active and protecting your account
totp.scanQrSubtitle: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password)
totp.manualSecretTitle: Or enter this secret key manually:
totp.verifySubtitle: Enter the 6-digit verification code displayed in your authenticator app
totp.invalidCode: Invalid verification code. Please check your authenticator app and try again.
totp.backupSubtitle: Save these 10 one-time emergency codes. Each code can be used once if you lose access to your device.
totp.confirmBackupCheckbox: I have saved these backup codes in a safe location
totp.disableConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to disable 2FA? Your account will only be protected by your master password.
totp.challengeSubtitleNoBackup: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
totp.challengeOrPasskeySubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or authenticate with your passkey.

passkeys.title: WebAuthn Passkeys
passkeys.subtitle: Log in and unlock your vault securely using Touch ID, Face ID, or a FIDO2 security key
passkeys.notSupported: WebAuthn / Passkeys are not supported on this device or browser
passkeys.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this passkey?
passkeys.managedByGoogleDesc: Your biometric passkeys (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello) and trusted devices are managed and protected directly by your Google account.
passkeys.challengeSubtitle: Confirm it is you with one of your passkeys.
passkeys.signInOnlyBadge: Sign-in only (vault asks for your password)
passkeys.addConfirmDescription: Confirm your identity: your password also wraps the vault key for this passkey.
passkeys.registeredWithoutPrf: Passkey added. This authenticator cannot unlock the vault, so your password will still be asked after signing in.
passkeys.enableVaultUnlockPrompt: Passkey added. Your browser needs one more confirmation so it can also unlock the vault.

stepUp.title: Security Verification
stepUp.description: Please confirm your identity before proceeding with this sensitive operation.
stepUp.recentSignInRequired: For your security, sign out and sign in again with Google, then retry within 10 minutes.
stepUp.recentSignInOk: You signed in recently with Google: confirm to continue.
stepUp.passkeyRequired: You will confirm with one of your passkeys.

totpVerifyModal.title: Two-Factor Verification Required
totpVerifyModal.subtitle: Enter your 6-digit authenticator code or an 8-character backup code
totpVerifyModal.invalid: Invalid code or already used backup code

secrets.title: Secrets Vault (API Keys)
secrets.subtitle: Store your AI and market provider credentials encrypted locally under your vault
secrets.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this API key?
secrets.savedSuccess: Secret key securely saved in vault.

audit.title: Security Audit Log
audit.subtitle: Append-only trace of authentication events, key modifications, and access attempts
audit.clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear the security audit log?

unavailable.title: Local data server unreachable
unavailable.description: GlassFolio keeps your data on the local server (the Docker volume), and that server did not answer. Your data is safe; nothing was changed.
unavailable.hint: Check that the container is running, then try again.

browserOnly.title: Data stored in this browser only
browserOnly.description: No local data server was found, so your data lives in this browser. Clearing the browser data or switching browser will erase it. Export a backup regularly, or run GlassFolio with Docker to store it on your machine.

saveError.title: Changes not saved to the local server
saveError.description: The latest changes could not be saved. GlassFolio keeps retrying automatically; keep this tab open until this message disappears.

legacyIgnored.title: A different vault was found in this browser
legacyIgnored.description: This browser still holds another vault than the one on the local server. The server vault is used and the browser copy was left untouched. Export it from the old setup if you need it.

settings.title: Data storage
settings.neverSaved: Nothing saved yet in this session
settings.serverHelp: Your encrypted data is stored on the machine running GlassFolio. Clearing your browser or changing browser does not affect it.
settings.browserHelp: Your data is stored in this browser. Run GlassFolio with Docker to keep it on your machine.
